I will plant rice on this 0.85 hectare plot using the rains, because here in Mwanza I usually depend on the season and I do not have irrigation for this field. I will use improved seed if I can get it, and I will put some chemical fertilizer, but not too much because cash is limited. I will not use much manure on this plot, and I do not expect to spray pesticide unless there is a serious problem, so for this season I will not plan on it.
